verify.subject: Confirm your email for Voyager
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Hi {{username}}, welcome to Voyager! Confirm your email address to finish setting up your account. This link works for {{minutes}} minutes.
verify.ignore: If you didn't create a Voyager account, you can safely ignore this email.
reset.subject: Reset your Voyager password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: Hi {{username}}, we got a request to reset your Voyager password. Use the button below to choose a new one. This link works for {{minutes}} minutes.
reset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
already_registered.subject: You already have a Voyager account
already_registered.heading: You already have an account
already_registered.body: Hi {{username}}, someone tried to sign up for Voyager with this email address, but you already have an account. You can sign in, or reset your password if you've forgotten it.
already_registered.ignore: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email; nothing has changed.
footer: Sent by Voyager. Please don't reply to this message.
